Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience as a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or within a similar transactional finance role.
- Practical credit control experience, including managing customer accounts and chasing outstanding payments.
- Good understanding of purchase ledger, invoice processing and account reconciliations.
- Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident communication skills, particularly when dealing with customers regarding outstanding payments.
- Ability to manage workloads independently while contributing to a wider team.

Desirable Experience
- Experience supporting payroll processing.
- Knowledge of Sage Line 50.
- AAT qualification or equivalent.

We are looking for someone who is positive, reliable and willing to get involved. You will be comfortable taking responsibility for your own workload, supporting colleagues when needed and going the extra mile to ensure the finance function runs smoothly.
